description: A full-height unit in scratched enamel white, the kind every third kitchen in the city seems to have inherited off the last tenant. Twin doors, a magnetic seal that still bites, and just enough room behind the crisper drawer to hide something from a roommate. The manufacturer's decal reads FROSTLINE — CIVIC SUPPLY DIV., in the cheerful sans-serif of a company that stopped answering warranty claims years ago.
